changelog.summary: Adds a processor-dispute review, exact finance handoff, provider outcome and ledger verification route.

title: Dispute to Reconciled Outcome
description: Prepare one SaaS payment dispute for owner review, then track its actual provider and finance outcome without submitting evidence implicitly.
setup_prompt: Use Dispute to Reconciled Outcome as a chat-led proposal. Inspect the existing Billing Operations Coordinator with Dispute Review and Revenue & Close Analyst, the exact processor dispute and charge, current deadline, reason, submission history, authorized evidence, owner policy, provider outcome and ledger. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact artifact validation, one manual case, and separate submission approval. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not submit evidence, contact a customer, change a ledger, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Exact entity, processor account and mode, dispute, payment and customer IDs
Current reason, status, amount, currency, deadline and prior submission records
Authorized agreement, usage, delivery and contact evidence with privacy and approval policy
Authorized settlement and ledger records for this dispute
Dispute, submission and finance review owners
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated event and follow-up cadence

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create only reviewed missing Crew identities with stable keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass the bounded validated dispute artifact to Finance

recommended_tools.name: Payment processor dispute read access or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact dispute, payment, deadline, status, submission and outcome receipts

recommended_tools.name: Agreement, product usage and support record access
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized reason-relevant evidence with stable source IDs

recommended_tools.name: Settlement and accounting ledger access or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify principal and any fee treatment after provider outcome

recommended_tools.name: Separately approved processor submission route
recommended_tools.purpose: Submit the exact approved evidence and retain a provider receipt

pulse_focus.label: Dispute response and finance outcome
focus_areas: Whether the current case and deadline are owned with reason-relevant evidence gaps visible
Whether submission, provider decision and finance reconciliation are each backed by their own receipts
review_when: A dispute status or deadline changes, an owner decides, a provider outcome arrives, or a ledger difference remains open

outputs: Reviewed dispute case, source inventory, missing evidence and deadline
Validated dispute-to-finance artifact for the exact payment and provider case
Provider-submission and outcome state with receipts when separately authorized or observed
Principal and fee finance state or an explicit unresolved difference
Manual case evidence, owner decisions, action ledger and activation choice
